say:10:1910148006:1.text: I don't know what you thought earlier, but the more I think about it, the more it pisses me off!

say:15:1910148011:1.text: Big guy, I'm doing this for your sake! And you don't even care! You're just lying there, sleeping like a baby...
say:15:1910148011:1.source_cn: 大个子，咱是为了你好！你倒好，一脸不在乎，还睡得舒舒服...

say:17:1910148012:0.text: Just as Tolan is about to lose his temper, there's a knock at the door.
say:17:1910148012:0.source_cn: 正在图澜急得差点跳脚的时候，外面传来了几声轻柔的敲门声。

say:18:1910148013:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Tolan? Why are you two still awake?
say:18:1910148013:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Tolan? Why are you two still awake?
say:18:1910148013:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Tolan? Why are you two still awake?

say:20:1910148015:0.text: Is everything alright? Can we come in?
say:20:1910148015:0.source_cn: 客人们，请问有什么能帮忙的吗？我们可以进来吗？

say:23:1910148017:0.text: Open the door. I'll take responsibility for this!
say:23:1910148017:0.source_cn: 把门打开，咱一人做事一人当！

say:27:1910148019:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> had nothing to do with this! He doesn't know anything!
say:27:1910148019:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> had nothing to do with this! He doesn't know anything!
say:27:1910148019:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> had nothing to do with this! She doesn't know anything!

say:28:1910148020:1.text: If you're angry, punish me! Yell at me, beat me up, kick me out, whatever!
say:28:1910148020:1.source_cn: 你们要是不爽，就罚咱一个人，要骂要打，还是要把咱赶走，...

say:29:1910148021:1.text: Just leave him out of it!
say:29:1910148021:1.male: Just leave him out of it!
say:29:1910148021:1.female: Just leave her out of it!

say:30:1910148022:1.text: Huh? Oh, I get it! You mean that way of dividing things that surface people do!
say:30:1910148022:1.source_cn: 嗯……你说什么？啊，我想起来了，是你白天说的“陆地分配...
say:30:1910148022:1.male: Huh? Oh, I get it! You mean that way of dividing things that surface people do!
say:30:1910148022:1.female: Huh? Oh, I get it! You mean that way of dividing things that surface people do!

say:31:1910148023:1.text: I'm sorry! It totally slipped my mind... I was actually going to ask you more about how things work on land.
say:31:1910148023:1.source_cn: 哎呀，真抱歉，我差点把这件事给忘了……本来还想多问你们...
say:31:1910148023:1.male: I'm sorry! It totally slipped my mind... I was actually going to ask you more about how things work on land.
say:31:1910148023:1.female: I'm sorry! It totally slipped my mind... I was actually going to ask you more about how things work on land.

narration:33:1910148025:0.text: Elphira does her best to explain the idea of rewarding people according to their contributions.
narration:33:1910148025:0.source_cn: 艾菲拉依照记忆，磕磕绊绊地为沫霖解释了“按劳分配”的观念……

say:34:1910148026:1.text: I see. So that's how people on the surface live. It really is quite different from our ways.
say:34:1910148026:1.source_cn: 原来这是陆地的习惯，和海裔有很大差异呢。

say:35:1910148027:1.text: I get it. I'll talk to Grandma in the morning, and we'll go on another hunt.
say:35:1910148027:1.source_cn: 我知道了，明天早上我和阿嬷说一声，我们再出去围猎一次。

say:36:1910148028:1.text: Uh-huh! Well, if that's all, we'll let you get some sleep. Goodnight!
say:36:1910148028:1.source_cn: 嗯！既然没什么事，那我们先告辞了，你们也早点休息。

say:37:1910148029:1.source_cn: ……喂，等一下！你……你们就这么走了？

say:38:1910148030:0.text: Hm? Do you need help putting those supplies away?
say:38:1910148030:0.source_cn: 嗯？需要我们帮忙整理这些物资吗？

say:40:1910148032:1.text: You... You're not angry? Don't you wanna yell at me or something?!
say:40:1910148032:1.source_cn: 你们……难道就不生气？不想骂咱？

say:41:1910148033:1.text: But you're our friend! Why would we be angry with you?
say:41:1910148033:1.source_cn: 你们是我的朋友呀，我为什么要生气，要骂你们？

say:42:1910148034:0.text: You took the supplies because you needed them. So of course you should have them!
say:42:1910148034:0.source_cn: 你拿走那些物资是因为你需要它，既然需要，那当然应该给你们啊。

say:44:1910148036:1.source_cn: 早点睡吧……呵欠……晚安啦，大家。

say:48:1910148038:1.text: I don't get it. Why aren't they furious?
say:48:1910148038:1.source_cn: 咱不明白，为什么她们不生气？
say:48:1910148038:1.male: I don't get it. Why aren't they furious?
say:48:1910148038:1.female: I don't get it. Why aren't they furious?

say:49:1910148039:1.text: If I pulled a stunt like this back in Kaflan, my old man would've chased me through the village with a club! And it wouldn't have been the first time, either.
say:49:1910148039:1.source_cn: 要是在卡什澜，咱干了这种事，一定会被老头子追着满村打，...
say:49:1910148039:1.male: If I pulled a stunt like this back in Kaflan, my old man would've chased me through the village with a club! And it wouldn't have been the first time, either.
say:49:1910148039:1.female: If I pulled a stunt like this back in Kaflan, my old man would've chased me through the village with a club! And it wouldn't have been the first time, either.

say:50:1910148040:1.text: So why... why aren't they angry?!
say:50:1910148040:1.male: So why... why aren't they angry?!
say:50:1910148040:1.female: So why... why aren't they angry?!

choice_prompt:51:1910148040.male: So why... why aren't they angry?!
choice_prompt:51:1910148040.female: So why... why aren't they angry?!

say:52:1910148041:1.text: I know... It's just... I don't know how to explain it.
say:52:1910148041:1.source_cn: 咱知道。就是感觉……咱说不清。
say:52:1910148041:1.male: I know... It's just... I don't know how to explain it.
say:52:1910148041:1.female: I know... It's just... I don't know how to explain it.
